description: OpenAPI 3 surface-change reports + a stateful crawler-callable monitor. GET /watch?token=my-api&url=<real openapi.json> stores a baseline and returns only what changed; POST /compare compares two specs; POST /batch compares up to 25 pairs. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/api-change-check/batch

token.description: A stable label you choose for this API, e.g. my-api-prod. Use the same token each run so I compare against your last baseline.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JSON OpenAPI 3 document.

name: api_change_check__batch
